parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is one of the two blade-handle assemblies of the scissors, made of stainless steel, combining a sharp cutting blade and a handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a handle for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to open and close against the other blade-handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade-handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel, forming the complementary cutting edge and handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first blade-handle set to perform the cutting action when the handles are squeezed together.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw, moving in opposition to the first blade-handle set to create a shearing motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade-handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, enabling rotational movement of the two blade-handle sets around it.
